text:
deploy-bot: rollout complete: canary -> eu-west-1 (rev: r12.4.0). postdeploy smoke started. dashboard: https://console.redwood.dev/releases/r12.4.0

alice: saw a couple of failing synth probes for /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1, p95 spikes and a few 503s. grabbing logs now.

ben: confirming, same. synthetic runner shows 3/120 failures in the last 5m, all 503 from host gpu-eu-3.

carol: posting sample curl output:```curl -i -X POST https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Fri, 21 Mar 2026 14:05:11 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"backend_unavailable"}```

oncall-bot: incident-check: probed hosts gpu-eu-1..gpu-eu-5 -> gpu-eu-3 failing healthcheck (502/503) since 14:03:07. Autorestart attempted by infra-agent.

dinesh: I see elevated KV cache miss rate on gpu-eu-3 right before the 503s, could be a prefill race with new model variant. Any warmup logs?

alice: warmup logs show prefill started 14:01:48, completed 14:03:00, but the agent reported a partial prefill error: "prefill_orphaned_segment: missing_kv_block" on that host.

ben: hmm. That sounds like an incomplete local cache state causing transient rejects. Does the deploy pin system still have fallback to previous variant?

carol: yes, rollout policy: canary -> gradual. Fallback policy: immediate route-away from failing host to previous variant in same region, but only if probe failure rate > 1%. We're at ~2.5% for region (3/120).

eva: suggestion: temporarily pin eu-west-1 traffic to r12.3.9 (previous stable) for embed-route only, while we drain/repair gpu-eu-3. Fast rollback at route-layer instead of global rollback.

alice: agree. Quick checklist: 1) pin route to r12.3.9 for /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 2) drain gpu-eu-3 and run prefill with verbose logs 3) re-run synth coverage 4) unpin if green.

deploy-bot: action queued: pin request created (ticket: RB-4432). To confirm: apply pin now? :white_check_mark: / :x: 

ben: +1 apply pin now. We don't want more downstream users hitting errors.

carol: applying pin to routing-table (embed-route, eu-west-1) -> pinned to r12.3.9. propagating...

deploy-bot: pin applied at 14:07:02 UTC. Routing change id: rc-1768504321-pin. Rolling traffic off gpu-eu-3.

oncall-bot: host-action: started cordon gpu-eu-3, draining connections.

alice: kicked off a verbose prefill on gpu-eu-3 with debug flag and kv-dump enabled. command:```infractl host prefill gpu-eu-3 --variant r12.4.0 --debug --dump-kv /tmp/kv-dump.json```

dinesh: I'll watch KV dump and compare with healthy host (gpu-eu-2). ping me when dump available; will grep for missing blocks.

eva: re-run synthetic runner against eu-west-1 now that pin is applied to make sure region-level error rate drops.

ben: synth run: 0/120 failures in last 2m after pin, p95 back to normal 45ms. Nice.

alice: prefill completed on gpu-eu-3 with errors shown earlier; after a manual kv-repair process it retried and now shows no missing segments. Logs: "prefill_ok: repaired_orphan_segments=2"

carol: host back to ready state. oncall-bot reports healthchecks passing for gpu-eu-3 for 3 consecutive minutes.

dinesh: KV diff looks good, no orphaned segments remaining.

eva: plan: keep pin in place for 15m while we run full smoke suite (tokenizer + embeddings + chat) then unpin if stable. Anyone object?

ben: fine. also file a postmortem note for prefills: possible race when prefill starts before model weight sync completes.

alice: filing follow-up ticket: INF-1129 "prefill race -> orphaned KV segments" assigned to eng-runtime. Add model onboarding checklist item.

deploy-bot: scheduled unpin check at 14:22:00 UTC. Will notify channel with results.

carol: quick release-note add: under r12.4.0 -> Known issues: transient prefill race in eu-west-1 observed, temporary routing pin applied; fixed by draining host and KV repair.

eva: thanks all. keeping monitoring for next 20m then will unpin if no regressions. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: postdeploy summary at 14:22:00 UTC: region eu-west-1 embed-route pinned -> r12.3.9 at 14:07:02; pin removed at 14:22:10 (successfully rolled forward to r12.4.0 after host repaired). No further 5xx in 20m sample. Ticket RB-4432 closed.
